objective: Animate these first and last anchors as a reusable chroma-keyed 11-second retro game overlay. Hold the lower-left lavender-outline Wario-head bomb fixed. Burn horizontal fuse from RIGHT to LEFT with a small orange-yellow spark. After ten full seconds, an opaque faceted comic explosion spreads from lower left across the whole canvas then clears completely to green. Eleven seconds total. 0.0-0.4 hold. 0.4-9.7 consume fuse steadily right to left. 9.7-10.0 final spark reaches bomb. No explosion before10.0. 10.0-10.6 explosion expands to cover whole canvas. 10.6-11.0 clears completely to flat green. Static camera and perfectly flat RGB0,255,0 matte. Only fuse/spark/explosion move. No face, character body, hands, frame, gloves, scenery, text or camera movement. Burst may cover entire portrait area. Keep exact green matte throughout; no gradients, shadows or green spill. Crisp low-poly Nintendo polygon style and pale lavender fuse. Silent. Final frame exactly plain green.
